coverage: Project CRUD, atomic membership and branch families
Workspace scopes, optimistic concurrency and deletion
Knowledge intake, extraction, file references and context assembly
Explicit and automatic memory, evidence validation and capacity
Canonical history, server tools and inference admission
SQLite and Convex project ownership readers
Filesystem and S3 uploads, commits, quotas and retry behavior

fixed.issue: Same-clock sync membership replacements were overwritten by stale editor saves.
fixed.repair: Compare membership data as well as clock inside the captured write transaction.

fixed.issue: Title synchronization converted same-ID documents/files into chats or updated the wrong kind.
fixed.repair: Require both matching ID and matching kind.

fixed.issue: An editor could resurrect an internal record remotely deleted at the same clock/content.
Post-commit extension failures made durable project deletion look unsuccessful.
fixed.repair: Report individual post-commit notification failures and preserve successful deletion.

fixed.issue: Legacy membership indexing normalized IDs/kinds but ownership resolution and removal did not.
fixed.repair: Use one entry normalization for canonical identity and preserve unrelated extension fields.

fixed.issue: Workspace project tools moved only one chat, stranding branches in another project and invalidating shared history.
fixed.repair: Use the existing atomic family-move writer and after-commit notifications; retain foreign-owned branches on removal.

fixed.issue: Over 500 retained deleted memories permanently disabled automatic capture, including when tombstones synced during inference.
fixed.repair: Count only live records toward capacity; bound dismissed deduplication references independently and retain exact tombstone protection.

fixed.issue: A declared raster MIME bypassed extraction even when stored signature classification rejected it, then unnecessarily required vision or sent invalid image bytes.
fixed.repair: Use final imported metadata and require its validated image kind as well as supported MIME.

fixed.issue: Awaited server tools leaked returned content or thrown error text after project ownership, chat availability or workspace authority changed.
fixed.repair: Reauthorize canonical ownership and workspace access before delivering either handler outcome.

fixed.issue: Memory inference buffered an unbounded HTTP body before enforcing its state schema limit.
fixed.repair: Use the existing streaming JSON reader with a 256 KiB envelope cap and retain the 240 KiB state cap.

fixed.issue: SQLite canonical history retained missing, deleted or foreign explicit project pointers and stranded released chats.
fixed.repair: Verify the explicit owner is live in the authorized workspace; release stale ownership without falling back to old folders.

fixed.issue: Convex canonical history retained missing, deleted or foreign explicit project pointers and stranded released chats.
fixed.repair: Verify the explicit owner inside the authorized query; rebuild the scaffold pack and contract digests.

fixed.issue: SQLite treated padded IDs and differently cased legacy chat kinds as unowned, bypassing browser project isolation.
fixed.repair: Normalize legacy IDs/kinds consistently with the browser and continue ignoring document/file/extension entries.

fixed.issue: Convex treated padded IDs and differently cased legacy chat kinds as unowned, bypassing browser project isolation.
fixed.repair: Normalize legacy IDs/kinds consistently with the browser and rebuild scaffold artifacts.

followUps.issue: The workflow plugin omits model origins and supplies null tool authority, so post-admission project moves cannot be fenced by the host.
followUps.requiredWork: Carry originating user/workspace/thread/message and cancellation through runtime ports and model/tool calls, with lifecycle regression coverage.

resolution.summary: Workflow runtime ports carry user/workspace/thread/message, job origin and combined cancellation. Host model/tool dispatch checks the active job, live execution message, fresh write access and canonical ownership; tools recheck before delivery. Missing origins refuse.

followUps.issue: Filesystem presign lacked atomic quota reservation and commit provenance; concurrent uploads could exceed a workspace quota.
followUps.note: Independent edits added reserve/consume binding during this audit. This task made no FS changes and does not claim acceptance of those edits.

resolution.summary: Filesystem reserves atomic upload quota before signing; commit consumes the matching intent before publishing the sidecar. Failed consumption/sidecar publication can retry.

followUps.issue: S3 wrote a commit marker before fallible intent consumption; transient failure or response loss poisoned retries with permanent 409s.
followUps.note: Independent edits changed consumption/marker ordering and matching-marker reconciliation during this audit. This task made no S3 changes and does not claim acceptance.

resolution.summary: S3 consumes the bound intent before marker publication and reconciles matching markers after conditional-write conflicts. Mismatched tuples refuse.

followUps.issue: Consumed reservations stopped counting before canonical file metadata arrived, permitting quota overshoot in the commit-to-sync gap.
followUps.note: Independent upload lifecycle changes were in progress; their suites reported failures separately from project ownership regressions.

resolution.summary: Native SQLite and D1 retain consumed quota during valid receipt authorization until canonical metadata arrives. Exact replay cannot outlive original expiry. Convex commits canonical metadata and consumes the intent within its mutation.

followUps.issue: Internal-record after-write hooks may run before a caller's outer transaction commits, so observers can react to a save later rolled back.
followUps.requiredWork: Define a caller-owned after-commit notification queue without awaiting outer completion from within that transaction.

resolution.summary: Nested project saves defer post/reference notifications to the outermost Dexie commit outside its transaction context. They return without waiting for the outer commit; rollbacks emit nothing.

followUps.issue: Older providers without projectOwnership retain warning-only fallback for legacy folder membership.
followUps.note: Documentation now reflects the existing compatibility behavior; changing that policy would affect older provider deployments.

resolution.summary: Unresolved canonical ownership refuses server tools/workflows, including older providers. The warning-only fallback was removed. Provider/backend upgrades are required before retrying.

followUps.issue: Legacy ownership scans all projects in the workspace; very large workspaces may reach latency or Convex read limits.

validation.regressionProof: New regression cases were written and demonstrated failing before their production fixes.
